caption: The drawing consists of a single object, a geometrically symmetrical vessel or architectural form, rendered in fine pencil lines on an off-white or slightly yellowed paper background. The object is composed of several stacked sections: a small, rounded knob or finial at the top, a cylindrical form beneath it, a disk-like flange, followed by a wider, tapering section that curves outward and down to form a bowl-like base, all resting on a broad, circular foot. A faint vertical guideline bisects the object vertically. In the upper left corner of the page, there is a smaller rectangle containing a simplified, straight-on outline of the same object, drawn with the same thin pencil lines. The overall composition is sparse, with the majority of the page left blank except for the main object situated to the right of center and the small inset in the corner. There is no shading or color beyond the natural tones of the pencil and the paper.
